prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 13 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, bright soft daylight from the windows behind the desk.

Image 14: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 15: the prop small dumbbell; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran sits in the black leather executive chair behind the walnut desk, her back to the floor-to-ceiling windows, with one hand raised in a go-ahead gesture. The four applicants stand in one row in the open space in front of the desk, facing her. From the lounge end they stand in this order: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT holding the small dumbbell at his side, then BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, then GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, then SHIRTLESS APPLICANT still in his black T-shirt. Xu Banxia stands at the lounge end of the desk, facing the applicants. The office door in the wall facing the desk stands open and empty. The camera stays on the lounge side of the desk-to-door axis.
Panel 1: Medium shot, handheld, low angle, from the lounge side. GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT curls the small dumbbell with both hands. His face is screwed up and his arms shake theatrically.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, quick push in, eye-level, from the lounge side. BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT throws a stiff, awkward punch toward the desk and wobbles off balance.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT wrestles his tight grey T-shirt up over his stomach, and the fabric gets stuck at his chest.
Panel 4: Medium shot, slow orbit around SHIRTLESS APPLICANT, low angle, staying on the lounge side. SHIRTLESS APPLICANT pulls off his black T-shirt and tosses it aside. He is now bare-chested in orange track trousers. He flexes both biceps and licks his lips.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, high angle, on the arms of the leather chair. Ji Ran's hands clench the arms of the black leather executive chair.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran covers her forehead with one hand and shuts her eyes.
Panel 7: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, from the lounge side. Xu Banxia, at the lounge end of the desk, turns her face away from the applicants and hides it behind her hand. Her shoulders shake with embarrassment.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran's shoulder, eye-level, from the lounge side. Xu Banxia lowers her hand and bends toward Ji Ran with an awkward smile.
Panel 9: Medium shot, tilt up following Ji Ran as she rises, low angle, from the lounge side. Ji Ran pushes up from the leather chair, waves both hands at the row and shields her eyes.
Panel 10: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Xu Banxia nods quickly behind her gold-rimmed glasses.
Panel 11: Wide shot, tracking with Ji Ran from the desk toward the door wall, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran strides around the lounge end of the walnut desk toward the office door, and the applicants shuffle aside to let her pass.
Panel 12: Close-up, whip pan to the doorframe, eye-level, from the lounge side. A hand in a damp denim sleeve slaps against the doorframe of the office door.
Panel 13: Medium close-up, slow push in, low angle, from the lounge side. Lin Qingyu braces himself against the doorframe in his open denim jacket. His hair is wet and sweat beads on his forehead. He looks up at Ji Ran, who stops short in front of him.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
